age.evidence: Adult Sprague Dawley rats ( n = 12, 6 male, 6 female, weight 300 -350 g)

sex.evidence: Adult Sprague Dawley rats ( n = 12, 6 male, 6 female

dosing.evidence: one of three doses of psilocybin (0.1, 1, or 10 mg/kg) was delivered (intravenous) over an hour... Each infusion session... was performed on a separate day with an interval of 5 -7 days between sessions

day_night_flipped.evidence: maintained on 12 h: 12 h light: dark cycle (lights ON at 8:00 am)

judge_notes: EEG / spectral / connectivity / PAC analyses are neural recordings and excluded per rubric.
Merged HTR and gyroscope locomotion into two separate assays — different behavioural constructs (stereotyped HTR vs locomotor activity), measured via different methods (video scoring vs gyroscope).
D1 set to 'Multiple discrete sessions' because each rat underwent 4 separate infusion-day recordings (saline + 3 doses) — multiple recording days for the same assay = multiple sessions per rubric.

D2 = 61 min-6 h because HTR was scored across the 60-min infusion plus 5-min pre-infusion baseline (~65 min continuous behavioural recording within a session); gyroscope covered the full ~90 min window.
B7 = 0: HTR scored manually from video; gyroscope is sensor-based position/movement readout (not behavioural classification beyond tracking).

assays.assay_description: Visual scoring of rhythmic rotational head movements from video recordings for 5 min pre-infusion and across the 60-min intravenous psilocybin/saline infusion; counts binned in 5-min epochs and summed for the full infusion.

application_type.evidence: one of three doses of psilocybin (0.1, 1, or 10 mg/kg) was delivered (intravenous) over an hour

setup_habituation.evidence: rats were connected to the EEG acquisition system between 9:00 and 9:30am and allowed to habituate for a minimum of 1 h... All rats were allowed at least 7 -10 days of post-surgical recovery, during which they were conditioned to the recording chambers

setup_restrain.evidence: rats were connected to the EEG acquisition system... freely moving in recording chamber; gently tapped on the recording chamber if slow waves appeared

food_restriction.evidence: ad libitum food and water in home cage; no mention of food in recording chamber

water_restriction.evidence: ad libitum food and water in home cage; no mention of water in recording chamber

time_to_assay.evidence: HTR was quantified... for the entirety of 60-min infusion period

sample_size.evidence: n = 12, 6 male and 6 female rats for all treatment groups except for 10 mg/kg group which had 5 male rats

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin dose-dependently induced HTR with an inverted U-shaped time course; both 1 mg/kg and 10 mg/kg significantly increased total HTR vs saline, while 0.1 mg/kg had no effect.
outcomes.statistics: 10 mg/kg vs saline 0-5 min p ≤ 0.0001; 1 mg/kg vs saline 5-10 min p = 0.0004; total HTR: 1 mg/kg p = 0.0362, 10 mg/kg p = 0.0308 (Tukey)
outcomes.evidence: Psilocybin dose-dependently induced the HTR and resulted in a biphasic inverted U-shaped dose-effect curve... infusion of both 1 mg/kg (p = 0.0362) and 10 mg/kg (p = 0.0308) psilocybin produced significant increases in head-twitches

B1_num_measures.evidence: HTR counts were either binned in 5-min epochs or summed for the entire 60-min infusion

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: HTR count data are presented as group means ± standard error of the means in 5-min bins

B4_ethological.evidence: HTR is explicitly excluded as ethological per rubric (stereotyped 5-HT2A response)

B5_social.evidence: rat tested alone in recording chamber

B6_cognitive.evidence: HTR is a reflexive motor response, no learning required

B7_automated_classification.evidence: The HTR was quantified using visual analysis of video recordings

E2_shelter.evidence: no shelter mentioned in recording chamber

E7_social_context.evidence: each rat tested individually during infusion sessions

D1_continuity.evidence: Each infusion session (0.9% saline or one of three psilocybin doses) was performed on a separate day with an interval of 5 -7 days between sessions

D2_session_duration.evidence: HTR was quantified... for the 5-min period prior to the start of intravenous infusion... and for the entirety of 60-min infusion period

D3_recording_days.evidence: Each rat received, on separate days, each of the three doses of psilocybin and vehicle control (4 recording days)

D4_baseline.evidence: HTR was quantified using visual analysis of video recordings for the 5-min period prior to the start of intravenous infusion

D5_followup.evidence: recording focused on baseline + 60-min infusion + 20 min post-infusion within the same day

assays.assay_description: 3-axis angular velocity captured via gyroscope sensor on the EEG head-stage during the 90-min experimental window (10-min baseline, 60-min infusion, 20-min post-infusion); binned in 10-min epochs.

application_type.evidence: one of three doses of psilocybin (0.1, 1, or 10 mg/kg) was delivered (intravenous) over an hour

setup_habituation.evidence: rats were connected to the EEG acquisition system... and allowed to habituate for a minimum of 1 h

setup_restrain.evidence: Rat activity and locomotion were captured using a 3-axis gyroscope sensor built into the EEG acquisition head-stage (freely moving)

time_to_assay.evidence: gyroscope data were binned in 10-min epochs during infusion

sample_size.evidence: n = 12, 6 male, 6 female; one 10 mg/kg session in a male rat was excluded

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin had a biphasic dose-dependent effect on locomotion: 0.1 mg/kg had no effect, 1 mg/kg briefly increased movement ~10 min into infusion, and 10 mg/kg significantly decreased movement (quiescent state) 30-50 and at 70 min.
outcomes.statistics: 0.1 mg/kg p > 0.05; 1 mg/kg p = 0.0069 (increased); 10 mg/kg p ≤ 0.023 (decreased) — FDR-corrected
outcomes.evidence: The 1 mg/kg dose induced a brief period (~10 min) of increased movements after 10 min of infusion (p = 0.0069)... The 10 mg/kg psilocybin produced a significant decrease in rat movements 30 -50 min and at 70 min (all p ≤ 0.023)

B1_num_measures.evidence: Analysis of the mean 3D angular velocity throughout the recording session

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: The gyroscope data were binned in 10-min epochs

B4_ethological.evidence: general locomotor activity, not natural behavioural repertoire

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Rat activity and locomotion were captured using a 3-axis gyroscope sensor (raw sensor data, not behavioural classification)

D1_continuity.evidence: Each infusion session was performed on a separate day with an interval of 5 -7 days between sessions

D2_session_duration.evidence: Gyroscope data covered the 90-min experimental window (10-min baseline, 60-min infusion, 20-min post-infusion)

D3_recording_days.evidence: Each rat received saline and three different doses of psilocybin on separate days (4 recording days)

D4_baseline.evidence: 10-min pre-psilocybin infusion baseline period included in analysis (gyroscope binned in 10-min epochs across the recording)

D5_followup.evidence: recordings did not extend ≥24 h post-dose
